record.dic_text:
05941 `Eliy {ay-lee'}

源自 05927; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Eli 33; 33

以利 = "升高"
1) 亞倫的後裔, 屬以他瑪家族一脈, 當撒母耳幼年入會幕服事時, 他是
   以色列的大祭司及士師
record.edic_text:
05941 `Eliy {ay-lee'}

from 05927;; n pr m

AV - Eli 33; 33

Eli = "ascension"
1) descendant of Aaron through Ithamar and high priest and judge of
   Israel when Samuel entered service as a child
